name: Samurai Revenge
author: Krylan, Dominik Koperkiewicz
description: An endless action game driven by revenge: run, jump and slide, deflect bullets with your sword and dash past walls for a high score. Sword, dash and slow motion use the mouse.

descriptions.en: An endless action game driven by revenge: run, jump and slide, deflect bullets with your sword and dash past walls for a high score. Sword, dash and slow motion use the mouse.
descriptions.it: Gioco d'azione infinito guidato dalla vendetta: corri, salta e scivola, devia i proiettili con la spada e scatta oltre i muri per il record. Spada, scatto e rallenty col mouse.
